name: Francevillian fossils
fact: Flat, lobed shapes up to 12 cm across in 2.1-billion-year-old shale in Gabon. Their finders think they were colonies of living things that grew in a regular way — the oldest large life by more than a billion years.
debate: Others think the shapes were made by minerals growing in the mud, or by microbial mats, not by many-celled life.
